dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with thin, high-intensity light grey perimeters. The edges show a sharp gradient transition from the light border to the darker brown/grey interior and exterior fur.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, discrete high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated on the posterior lateral flank and near the flipper insertion, lacking internal gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationship defined by a prominent triangle formed by the centroids of the two largest dorsal 'O' rings and a secondary 'C' ring located on the mid-lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct, high-contrast dark keratinous claws are visible on the distal margin of the right pectoral flipper.
